name: Spine
short_desc: Quotes, jobs, invoices and the books for a small service business
author: haribrothers
description: Spine runs a small service or project business from enquiry to quote, job, invoice, payment and the books. The double-entry accounting is derived from what you do, so the books keep themselves.

form_fields.label: Address for links
form_fields.hint: Spine writes it into emails, PDFs and invitations, and signs in there. Use the address you open Spine at, e.g. https://spine.hari.box (its local subdomain) or http://192.168.1.20:7746, with no slash at the end.

form_fields.label: Email server (SMTP host)
form_fields.hint: To send quotes, invoices and invitations. Without it, documents still issue and email waits to be sent.

form_fields.label: Backup passphrase
form_fields.hint: Encrypts backups. Keep it somewhere other than this machine: without it an encrypted backup can't be restored.
